data.text:
Luke, I appreciate you being honest about the cost, but matching an excessive catch doesn’t protect our incomes—it shrinks what we can earn next month. If we each take 10, that’s $10,000 each month while keeping the lake full. Our families and village need that dependable income.

I’ll choose 10 tons this month, and I’m asking everyone to agree to the same limit. Once catches are revealed, we can review them together and discuss any shortfall without starting a race to empty the lake. Kate, would you support 10 each instead?
